The Court Made The Following:
 Order
Respondent No.2 was served, but unrepresented.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the petition with liberty to file fresh petition after filing of the charge sheet.
3. Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners is placed on record.
Liberty sought for is granted.
4. Accordingly, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file a fresh petition after filing of the charge sheet.
In view of the dismissal of the main petition, I.A.No.1/2022 does not survive for consideration and the same is disposed of.
